extracted_keywords=[], source_weight=1.0, age_days=0, recipient_specific=False),
RAGResult(source="mock", source_type="MOCK",
text="Our product 'CloudScale Platform' and 'DataHub' solution...",
extracted_keywords=[], source_weight=1.0, age_days=0, recipient_specific=False),
RAGResult(source="mock", source_type="MOCK",

extracted_keywords=[], source_weight=1.0, age_days=0, recipient_specific=False)
